source_snapshot.population_ceiling: English-language namespace-0 non-redirect article revisions; IR-121 freezes further content-neutral eligibility and sampling

identity_record.canonical_rows: compact JSON arrays [role, name, bytes, md5, sha1] in files order

source_snapshot.local_sha256_rule: Compute SHA-256 after acquisition and reject the file unless bytes, MD5, and SHA-1 also match this record. Null is required before acquisition.

contract.source_identity: Dated dump file identity plus namespace-0 page ID and revision ID; exact source and derived layer bytes each retain SHA-256
contract.document_id: doc- plus the first 20 hexadecimal characters of SHA-256 over compact JSON [document-v1, immutable_source_id]
contract.tokenizer: metric_contract.json ASCII alphabetic token with internal straight or curly apostrophes; Unicode letters, numbers, and underscore prevent partial matches
contract.normalization: Replace curly apostrophe with straight apostrophe and apply ASCII lowercase at token level only; do not normalize source or extracted-text bytes
contract.offsets: Zero-based half-open Unicode character and UTF-8 byte offsets into exact extracted text
contract.token_id: t plus one-based token position, scoped by document_id
contract.token_hash: SHA-256 of compact JSON rows [token_id, normalized, character_start, character_end, byte_start, byte_end]
contract.occurrence_id: occ- plus the first 20 hexadecimal characters of SHA-256 over compact JSON [occurrence-v1, document_id, category, canonical_form, member_token_ids]
contract.mismatch_behavior: Exit 2 before emitting a verified report on any byte, hash, ID, token, offset, member, gap, or occurrence mismatch

remaining_gates: Acquire and verify both frozen files before sampling; record their local SHA-256 values in a superseding manifest version.
IR-121 must freeze the namespace-0 non-redirect frame, exclusions, strata, seed, and page/revision rows before target search.
Do not change preprocessing, tokenization, offsets, or ID formulas after annotation without a new version.
Do not claim that Wikipedia source text or a benchmark is available from this metadata-only freeze and project-authored probe.
